text:
marta: heads up — private deployment in eu-west reported 3x p99 latency this morning after the runtime 0.42.1 rollout. noticed it spikes under sustained small-chat/stream workloads.

alex: seeing same on staging. p95 stable but tail blows up. any immediate mitigations?

marta: I rolled back the kernel-selector flag on one node (to kernel-v1) and the latency dropped. reverting across the pool reduced incidents. looks tied to the new kernel selection heuristic.

jamal: infra metrics: NAT ephemeral port usage shot up ~40% correlated with the spike window. infra-bot posted an alert: `nat_port_pool_utilization > 85%` for several private clusters.

infra-bot: ALERT: private-nat-eu-west: port_pool_utilization=88% window=5m, syn_retries increased, egress_rtt ↑ 120ms.

priya: hm — could be noisy neighbors generating many short connections, causing port churn + premature conntrack cleanup. firewall state timeout is still default 60s. if ports churn, you get TCP collisions and RSTs which runtime interprets as tail latency.

alex: to add — we also pushed an experimental batching heuristic that coalesces tiny sequences more aggressively. profiling from runtime shows more frequent KV cache evictions during those bursts. eviction rate graph attached (internal link): https://logs.redwood/internal/kv/evict/1967

marta: pasted profile (sampling) from an affected instance:

```
# go pprof sampling
Total: 120s
50.3% runtime.scan
12.1% serving.kvCache.Evict
8.5% net/http.(*conn).read
6.7% kernelselector.selectKernel
```

jamal: kernelselector.selectKernel jumping between fragment-friendly kernel and low-latency kernel caused mismatched MTU handling on the private egress path. with ICMP blocked by customer firewall, PMTU discovery failed and we hit blackhole behavior for 1500->900 MTU paths. packets get dropped and retries inflate latency.

priya: so two compounding issues: 1) NAT ephemeral port exhaustion + state churn causing connection resets, 2) PMTU blackhole because kernel variant toggled fragmentation behavior and customer FW blocks ICMP. both increase retries and bump KV cache thrash.

alex: recommended immediate steps I pushed to a canary:
- pin kernel-selector to kernel-v1 (stable)
- increase NAT port pool on private gateways by 30% and bump conntrack max_entries by 20%
- temporarily relax KV cache eviction aggressiveness (lower eviction rate)

marta: after pin + nat bump, p99 improved within 5m. but we need a root cause plan.

jamal: action items:
- (jamal) run ephemeral port churn drill on staging to reproduce, capture `ss -tanp` + NAT mapping heatmap (due 1967890800)
- (priya) coordinate with customer ops to verify ICMP/fragment rules and recommend allowing ICMP unreachable for PMTU (reach out ticket #C-4121)
- (alex) add telemetry for kernel-selector flips at node-level + correlate with per-node MTU/path tests
- (marta) roll a patch to batching heuristic that prefers KV-cache locality for small-chats to reduce eviction bursts

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-196789 — Private egress tail latency (nat ports + pmtu) — Sev3.

marta: note for postmortem: don't conflate batching heuristics regressions with pure network faults — both can amplify each other. deep profiling + egress path observability key. :mag:
